name: Build Orbit: Ghost in the Pipeline
description:
A megacorp build server has triggered an intrusion alert. Log in on the lab network, scan 172.20.0.0/24 (challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199), and reconstruct what happened from host evidence to recover the flag from the genuine planted artifact.

---

**Access** — SSH `root@172.20.0.147`, password `OrbitGlass-44`

tasks.name: Recover the build server evidence
tasks.description: Inspect the compromised build server on the lab network. Scan 172.20.0.0/24 (challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199), compare the host's activity and records, and recover the flag from the genuine planted artifact.
hints: Build servers accumulate ordinary account, schedule, and login activity. Look for traces that do not fit the routine work.
Compare file modification time with change time; a backdated file can still have a recent ctime. Review SSH trust files alongside the logs and schedules.
Run stat on builder's SSH authorized_keys file, inspect its key comment, and decode the token there from Base64.
